question.text: Fee-only Investment Advisers earn their revenue primarily from:

answer.text: Fees charged to clients for advisory services
Trail commissions on mutual fund investments

explanation.text: The Logic: Fee-only Investment Advisers charge fees directly to clients for their services and do not earn commissions from product manufacturers. This eliminates the conflict of interest inherent in commission-based models. The Trap: Trail commissions are earned by distributors, not fee-only advisers.
